split.placement_rule: explicit case centers, radii and grid spacing; no random sampling

input_contract.ocr_context: fixed synthetic annotation and legend regions only
input_contract.axis_geometry: fixed oracle plot polygon; no fitting
input_contract.marker_annotation: fixture-drawn outline and center pixels used only for scoring
input_contract.crossing_annotation: fixture-drawn ordinary cross and grid pixels used only for scoring
input_contract.clutter_annotation: fixture-drawn block-letter strokes used only for scoring; not supplied as OCR text boxes
input_contract.prohibited_annotation: fixture-drawn arrow, bracket and legend pixels used only for scoring

candidate_rule: From the baseline structural probabilities, raise marker-like probability in the existing 5x5 center only when: the center has two long crossing line pairs; a strict same-radius circle or square outline supports at least 15 of 16 angular sectors using original ink pixels without the old 3x3 sector dilation; and there is no other long crossing within 12 pixels outside the center core.

criteria: candidate suppresses fewer annotated marker centers than baseline and does not add suppressed centers
candidate masks no additional annotated marker pixels
candidate masks no additional annotated text-like clutter pixels
candidate does not lose any baseline clear-cross or grid center mask
candidate does not reduce arrow, bracket, or legend truth-pixel coverage or region counts
